native_heaptrack.limits: Only short independent diagnostics; native malloc tracing excludes Boehm small allocations/mmap. SIGTERM final totals include live startup runtimes and are not per-request leaks.

gc_findings.previous_shared_fix: Long-run uncollectable 80-byte class is only 6 static slots in sampled snapshots; old wrapper retention is absent at its former scale.
gc_findings.remaining_small_slots: 16-byte kind2 mark slots increase in live long-run snapshots; dominant payload is pointer to preceding slot, consistent with free-list-shaped storage. Marked counts include free slots and are non-atomic, not a proven live-object leak. Exact retaining caller remains unconfirmed.
gc_findings.counter_underflow: GC_get_non_gc_bytes underflows in standalone serial, parallel and batch allocate/free programs as well as V thread churn. Batch GC heap returns fully free at fixed 196608 bytes. The uncollectable small-allocation fallback omits a counter increment while free subtracts it. This is a demonstrated accounting defect, not demonstrated cause of RSS growth.

release_gate: P0-02 remains blocked; do not count diagnostics toward soak duration and do not replace current soak.
